title: Adopt: ingest mapped ATS applications onto the board, keyed on the vendor id
deviations_from_card: (1) Per the coordinator's binding instruction, first imports go through the application-filing core (fileApplication, proof 'channel', stub, sendAck:false) rather than a direct createPipelineEntry + link in one IMMEDIATE tx; so app/_lib/application-filing.ts joined the write set with ONE additive optional input, `stage` (default unchanged: the axis entry column), and app/api/apply/apply-intake-scope.test.ts's source pin was updated to the new expression (still forbids a hardcoded landing stage). (2) The link is written after the filing, not in the same transaction (the core awaits); overlapping imports of one vendor id are serialized in-process instead. (3) A fifth outcome 'linked': a first import the core resolves to an applicant already on that opening (same email) is bound to that entry rather than duplicated - the filing core's identity rule, so the card's 'never fall back to name or email' holds for re-syncs (link-first) but not for the very first import. (4) Erased covers two paths: a linked anonymized (or missing) entry, and a link-less record whose dedupe key lands on the scrubbed row (stopped via the core's onEntry seam before any write, no link). (5) Extra codes: ATS_IMPORT_RECORDS_INVALID (400, maxRecords) and ATS_IMPORT_FAILED (store) beside ATS_IMPORT_JOB_NOT_FOUND; plus catalog key pipeline.intakeReasons.atsImported for the stub's coded reason. (6) scripts/docs/feature-doc-map.json gained two globs so the doc sync watches the new files. (7) Capability: pipeline:write (requireCapabilityCoded), beside requireOperator.
notes: Critic ruling honoured: no outbound wire shape changes (ats-webhook/ats-record untouched). Gates red only on FOREIGN in-flight work: tsc errors are all under kpi-sim/ (untracked) and app/features/tools/devcases/devcaseScoreHeadline.test.ts (devcase-core sibling); api:check blocks only on the sibling's uncommitted /api/pipeline/command/reverse (its row was deliberately left out of my api-reference commit); full test:unit BROKEN only on devcase-vocabulary.test.ts (devcase-core sibling's 'case score' catalog copy) plus a python-runner-concurrency FLAKE (timing), my apply-intake-scope source pin was fixed in b49204626; test:perf overages (page + ~9 routes + tasks/[id]/retry) measured in a detached worktree of base c2c6829d6 + ONLY my four source files: zero findings, so every overage line is siblings' uncommitted work. Known inherited gap (documented in the integrations README): when the dedupe key lands on an anonymized row, createPipelineEntry reactivates a terminal status before the guard stops the filing (no PII written) - that is createPipelineEntry's re-add rule the r06 cards are changing; building on the filing core inherits their fix. The api-reference commit (e659a159f) precedes the route's commit by minutes. No UI, no connector pull, no CV profile build (stub only) - stated as Known gaps. No rate-limit contract row: nothing spends or spawns.
